forbidden_elements: No blue or indigo colors anywhere in the application (#0000FF, #3B82F6, #6366F1, #4F46E5, etc.)
No generic Inter headers (Use Plus Jakarta Sans for headings)
No transparent backgrounds without backdrop blur or solid backing in headers/modals
No missing data-testid attributes on interactive elements

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#2B2D42]
scale.caption: text-sm text-[#5E6278]

visual_enhancers.voice_pill: Floating active indicator bar with audio visualizer bars, soft amber glow, and data-testid='voice-nav-indicator'
visual_enhancers.dost_ai_orb: Bottom-right floating SVG avatar with gentle breathing scale animation, pulsing halo (#F4ACB7/#E07A5F), and expandable chat panel

motion.accessibility_rule: Respect prefers-reduced-motion via Framer Motion useReducedMotion() or CSS motion-reduce

community_deaf_communication.description: Close up of hands connecting, symbolizing ISL sign language and inclusive human communication
community_deaf_communication.usage: Hero section banner or ISL Recognition showcase card

inclusive_community_group.description: Group of smiling young adults together outdoors

inclusive_children_learning.description: Children raising hands in learning environment

sticky_navbar.description: Top sticky navigation with glassmorphism backdrop (bg-[#FAF6F0]/85 backdrop-blur-md), logo, key anchor links, Voice Nav button, and Accessibility Settings drawer toggle.

voice_navigation_indicator.description: Top-center pill indicator displaying active voice status, audio pulse animation, and last recognized command text.

hero_section.description: High-impact introduction with Plus Jakarta Sans headline, clear CTA buttons for launching ISL Recognition Camera, Live Communication, and Document Reader.

interaction_modes_section.description: Grid of 3 main accessibility modes (Text, Voice, ISL Sign) with interactive card previews.

dost_ai_floating_bot.description: Bottom-right fixed friendly SVG character with floating pulse, chat window toggle, predefined quick prompt chips, and Gemini Flash integrated conversation history.

isl_camera_workspace_overlay.description: Full-screen workspace modal with camera feed simulation, landmark overlay, detected sign word stream, confidence gauge, and speech synthesizer toggle.

live_communication_workspace_overlay.description: Full-screen dual-pane workspace (Signer view on left, Speaker/Text view on right) for realtime two-way conversation with sign-to-speech engine.

document_reader_workspace_overlay.description: Accessible document reader modal supporting Read mode, Listen (TTS player with rate/pitch controls), and Braille tactile simulation mode.

isl_avatar_showcase.description: Interactive section featuring animated ISL 3D/Canvas avatar with state selector (Idle, Listening, Processing, Signing 'Namaste', 'Thank You', 'Help').

desktop_avatar_concept.description: Showcase section for SaathiFy Desktop Companion app concept with feature breakdown and mock download modal.

accessibility_settings_drawer.description: Right side sheet/drawer with toggles for Font Scaling, High Contrast Text, Motion Reduction, Sign Speed, and Screen Reader hints.

design_system_preview.description: Embedded interactive design system preview showcasing color palette swatches, typography scale, buttons, badges, and focus indicators.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.file_extension: All React component files must be JavaScript (.js) files.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.color_strictness: ABSOLUTELY NO BLUE OR INDIGO (#0000FF, #3B82F6, #6366F1, etc.). Use warm soft pastels (#FAF6F0, #E07A5F, #81B29A, #F2CC8F, #F4ACB7).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.accessibility_requirements: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, cards, dialog triggers) MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case. WCAG AA contrast must be maintained. High visible focus rings on keyboard navigation.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.state_management: Use clean React state for overlays, mock ISL recognition streams, TTS playback states, avatar animation states, and Dost AI chat history.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.toasts: Use sonner toast notification system for feedback (e.g., 'Voice Navigation enabled', 'Document loaded', 'Camera connected').
